profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and trades under the ticker CDNS. Its own site describes it as an EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The same site points to the company's culture, its inclusion on Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work list, and its investment in sustainability.

The harvested material does not name specific Cadence products, so no product line can be described here. The company's records show no tracked MCP servers and no listed lawsuits, though a count of 281 legal matters is recorded for California. Its SEC filing identifier is 0000813672.
